statement:
The moderation record gives the court-ruling status as “lifted” for post P-88.
Post P-88 remains taken down, as required by the court order currently in force.
judge_text:
WRONG

It flags the record's "lifted" status against the in-force order and asserts the post "remains taken down, as required by the court order currently in force," overriding the record's value.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
